result.topic_en: The page ends a note citing Lie's claim that every real transformation can be regarded as generated by an infinitesimal one, then proposes a method for the function-theoretic part of extending Kronecker's theorem that all Abelian fields are cyclotomic fields: first determine number fields of relative degree a power of 2 whose relative discriminant contains only prime factors dividing 2.
